description: Test file for managing sidebar categories and channels in Mattermost, including creation, updating, ordering, muting, and diffing channel movements between categories.

methods.name: TestSidebarCategory
methods.description: Tests creating, updating, reordering, and retrieving sidebar categories and their order.

methods.name: TestGetSidebarCategories
methods.description: Tests retrieving sidebar categories for a user and team, including pre-migration scenarios and error handling.

methods.name: TestUpdateSidebarCategories
methods.description: Tests muting/unmuting categories and channels, moving channels between categories, and their effects on channel mute states.

methods.name: TestDiffChannelsBetweenCategories
methods.description: Tests diffing channels between categories to identify moved channels and handle implicit moves.
